description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet prane stadiumit Dinamo,pozicionohet ne katin e dyte te nje ndertimi egzistues pa ashensor.Organizohet nga ambienti i ndenjes,ambienti i gatimit me vete,tre dhoma gjumi dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.Ambienti eshte i pershtatshem per banim por edhe per investim sepse ndahet lehtesisht ne dy apartamente.Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.(IRG122814)
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located near the Dinamo stadium, it is positioned on the second floor of an existing building without an elevator. It is organized by a living room, a separate kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The room is suitable for living but also for investment because it is easily divided into two apartments. The property has regular mortgage documentation. (IRG122814) For more information, contact us.
